messages:
oliver_marketing: Quickops for Tue 11am PT webinar 'Inference at scale: cost vs latency' — need a concise runbook: reg page, Zoom config, recording/captions, post-event routing. Who owns replay + clips?

maria_ops: I'll take the reg page + confirmation email. Planning an A/B CTA test: A) 'Register for live' B) 'Get recording & slides'. Adding UTM utm_source=twitter. HubSpot form fields mapped. GDPR checkbox copy ready. Need confirmation email copy.

jamal_grows: Lead routing owned by me. All leads -> tag 'webinar_bench_Tue317'. HubSpot -> SFDC: Owner -> Queue 'Inbound-webinar'; LeadStatus -> MQL. Set 4-day nurture and AE round-robin on replay publish. CC @ben_devrel for clip requests.

sophia_prod: Zoom: cloud recording + transcript (SRT) enabled. Also local host backup. Captions enabled. RTMP fallback configured. Greenroom 30m before. I'll run retention check and backup script: ./backup_recording.sh /tmp/zoom317.

ben_devrel: I'll create 3 clips and one 30s dev-focused intro. Need raw mp4, srt, and a timestamped highlight list. Can production add query param `?clip=true` on postflow to flag clip requests?

maria_ops: Hidden fields for reg page:

<!-- hidden fields -->
<input type='hidden' name='utm_source' value='twitter' />
<input type='hidden' name='campaign' value='benchmark_mar2026' />

Also confirmation subject: 'Thanks for registering — webinar replay & slides'. Include privacy link and GDPR checkbox: 'I agree to receive marketing emails from Redwood Inference.' Detect visitor timezone to show local start time.

oliver_marketing: Run-of-show uploaded: https://docs.google.com/1abcDEF — speakers @anna, @kevin. I'll ping them with greenroom times. Who will publish the replay? @jamal_grows?

jamal_grows: I'll publish replay within 6 hours and make 3 short clips by EOD. Need SRT + highlight timestamps from production.

zoom-bot: Zoom meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 Passcode: Redwood! Recording: cloud enabled. Transcript: enabled. Meeting ID: 1234567890

sophia_prod: :thumbsup: I'll verify cloud retention and confirm local backup exists before ending meeting.

maria_ops: Confirmation email flow: send immediate with slides link placeholder, follow-up 24h with replay + CTA to request demo. HubSpot smart list tag: webinar_benchmark_2026.

oliver_marketing: Perfect. I'll assemble final checklist and share the document. :party-parrot:
